# 退款政策 Refund Policy

退款申请会在五个工作日内处理。Refund requests are processed within five business days.

| 项目 | 时限 |
| --- | --- |
| 审核 | 1 business day |
| 退款 | 5 business days |

## 例外 Exceptions

超过三十天的订单需要人工审核。Orders older than thirty days require manual review.
